release_notes: Orbitra 2.1.2: the AI assistant now does the everyday work with you. It knows which campaign, landing or offer you have open, offers the right next step for that page, and asks for confirmation in plain words (headline variants with a checkbox each, stream shares as "was 30% → will be 70%"). It sets stream shares, switches streams on and off, starts and stops campaigns and re-weighs offers and landings inside a stream; the same four actions are available to external assistants over MCP. Dashboard: the columns of the top 10 tables are your pick (cost, revenue and profit with the finance right), a new Countries (Top 10) block, and "Hide rows without data". Reports is an item of the main menu, and the conversions log filters by geo, campaign, offer and site. Fixed: changing one stream through MCP could reset that stream and delete the others; postback parameter aliases now save and work; system settings accept the retention fields; the report table sorts by column; the postback key is rotated from the panel; a postback sent to an old or mistyped key is a 404 instead of a silent 200; the first-run wizard no longer leaves the public default key; "Manage DNS via" is back in the domain form; a failed cohort load no longer reads as "No data"; lists no longer show other campaigns' old clicks or money to users who should not see them. No migrations and no new cron lines.
